description.value: A pilot fMRI study evaluated brain responses to heroin-related versus neutral visual cues in heroin-dependent men following short-term and long-term abstinence.

spans.text: We evaluated the effect of short-term and long-term heroin abstinence on brain responses to heroin-related cues using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).

description.value: Between-subjects comparison of heroin-dependent subjects during short-term versus long-term abstinence; participants were recruited from an inpatient forced detoxification center.
